definitions.explanation: A bond issued by a national government to finance public spending. A key instrument in government finance.

examples.japanese: {国債|こくさい}を{発行|はっこう}する。
{日本|にほん}の{国債|こくさい}{残高|ざんだか}は{増|ふ}え{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: Japan's outstanding government debt keeps growing.

examples.japanese: {低金利|ていきんり}{時代|じだい}には{国債|こくさい}の{利回|りまわ}りも{低|ひく}くなる。
examples.english: In an era of low interest rates, government bond yields also fall.

notes:
USAGE:
A key financial and economic term frequently seen in news. {国債|こくさい} is the bond itself, not the aggregate national debt; the total is {国債|こくさい}{残高|ざんだか} or {国|くに}の{借金|しゃっきん}. Not to be confused with the homophone {国際|こくさい} (international), which is far more common in daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国債|こくさい}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue government bonds
- {国債|こくさい}{残高|ざんだか}: outstanding government debt
- {国債|こくさい}の{利回|りまわ}り: government bond yield
- {国債|こくさい}{市場|しじょう}: government bond market
- {赤字|あかじ}{国債|こくさい}: deficit-financing bonds

cross_references.description: Homophone. {国際|こくさい} means international.
